# RM brief — A NEW LIFE ABROAD LIMITED (04426729)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts; SEC-01 — Outstanding third-party charge  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- A New Life Abroad Limited (company number 04426729) is an active private limited company incorporated on 29 April 2002, so roughly 24 years of trading history, operating under SIC codes for real estate activities (68100, 68201, 68209, 68320). `[profile; computed]`
- There is a single active officer, though 11 officers have served in total over the company's life, and no new appointments have been made in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- One outstanding charge is registered, created on 12 August 2025 in favour of Aldermore Bank PLC, a third-party lender; it is secured on property at 57 Cover Circle, Cove Bay, Aberdeen, AB12 3DG. `[044267290001]`
- Under SEC-01, that outstanding third-party charge means we cannot offer a first-charge facility: any new lending would rank as a second charge unless the Aldermore charge is redeemed at completion. `[SEC-01; 044267290001]`
- Filing conduct is strong: accounts have been delivered consistently and almost always well ahead of the deadline, with only two late filings many years ago (2004 and 2008). The most recent accounts to 30 April 2026 were filed on 27 June 2026, some 215 days early, and nothing is currently overdue, with the next accounts not due until 31 January 2028. `[AA filed 2026-06-27; AA filed 2004-03-03; AA filed 2008-02-25; profile]`
- However, the latest accounts are micro-entity accounts, which disclose neither turnover nor profit, so CON-04 requires us to obtain management accounts covering the most recent 12 months before any decision can be taken. `[CON-04; AA filed 2026-06-27; profile]`
- On approach: the case is a REFER rather than a decline — request up-to-date management accounts and clarify whether the borrower intends to redeem or retain the existing Aldermore facility, since that determines the ranking of our security. `[CON-04; SEC-01]`
